svg.text: Automotive BLE-to-CAN bridge | TCAN4550-Q1 + CC2340R53 | 9-36 V vehicle input with 1S battery backup
No onboard charging by design — pack is charged externally
BLE 5.3 wireless MCU - Arm Cortex-M0+, 512 KB flash (VQFN-40)
CAN FD controller + transceiver, SPI slave (VQFN-20)
2 x 22 uF + 100 nF, no external load
Reverse battery: D102 blocks input; battery side blocked by U401.
D101: 40 V standoff, 64.5 V max clamp; validate transients.
Crank / brownout: buck EN divider 6.0 V on / 5.3 V off;
+3V3_SYS held by battery branch during dips.
Battery backup: MCU + BLE stay alive on 3.0 V rail;
TCAN4550 unpowered (VSUP is vehicle-only) - CAN offline,
nWKRQ pull-up defines MCU input while TCAN is off.
Power paths are ideal-diode ORed; no MCU source-select control.
